$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor completion.

enabled.description: Enable dynamic Zellij tab title updates.

emojiIdle.description: Prefix used when OpenCode is idle.

emojiRunning.description: Prefix used while OpenCode is running work.

emojiNeedsInput.description: Prefix used when OpenCode is waiting for human input.

debounceMs.description: Debounce time for tab title updates in milliseconds.

cleanupExitedPaneOnRead.description: Remove exited PTY panes after they are read.

sudoPane.description: Controls whether the sudo pane tool is available, denied, or hidden.

sudoPaneMode.description: How the sudo request pane is presented to the user. `floating` (default) opens a large, pinned floating pane without stealing focus; `fullscreen` opens a non-floating pane that Zellij focuses automatically.

sudoPaneFloatingSize.description: Size of the floating sudo pane. `width`/`height` accept a percent string (e.g. `80%`) or a bare integer in cells. `pinned` keeps the pane on top of other floating panes.
